hypothesis: A finite obstruction-first benchmark can distinguish sound recovery, certified terminal impossibility, budget exhaustion, lucky overclaiming, and unsupported or unnecessary abstention, while matched experiment-family enrichments switch registered tasks from impossible to recoverable.

controls.description: Mechanistic, causal, and automata task pairs share worlds and targets while the enriched family adds the registered separating experiments.
An always-guess baseline receives raw accuracy but not certified-recovery credit when its transcript leaves target-distinct worlds.
An always-abstain baseline receives no certified-impossibility credit without a valid terminal obstruction.
Target-equal, transcript-inconsistent, and permitted-experiment-separable pairs fail terminal-certificate validation.
World and target-label permutations preserve benchmark outcome classes.

gates.criterion: Every emitted terminal pair is transcript-consistent, target-distinct, and equal under all permitted experiments.
Recovery, terminal obstruction, budget exhaustion, guessing, and unsupported abstention remain distinct result classes.
All registered coarse task families are terminally obstructed and all enriched families recover every hidden world within budget.
Lucky guesses are scored as overclaims and unsupported or unnecessary abstentions receive no certified-impossibility credit.
Small finite-system classifications agree with direct enumeration.
The paper identifies the mathematical and counterexample-guided precedents and limits V0 to synthetic benchmark mechanics.
The public fixture and local command reproduce the committed JSON receipt without secrets or network access.
